name: Patient
definition: An individual person registered in the database, carrying demographic attributes (sex, birthday), a first visit date, an admission flag and a recorded diagnosis.
scope: Patient-level analysis of the autoimmune / collagen-vascular cohort in thrombosis_prediction

name: Examination Record
definition: A single clinical examination event for a patient, dated by Examination Date and recording thrombotic status, symptoms, diagnosis and antiphospholipid-related serology.
scope: Event-level analysis of thrombosis status and its serological correlates

name: Laboratory Record
definition: A single dated laboratory panel for a patient, holding general chemistry, haematology, coagulation, complement and autoantibody results.
scope: Longitudinal laboratory analysis per patient and per date

name: Patient Identifier
definition: The integer value carried by the ID column of Patient, Examination and Laboratory, intended to identify the patient to whom a record belongs.
scope: Cross-table linkage of examination and laboratory records to a patient

name: Thrombosis Grade
definition: The ordinal, never-null integer code stored in Examination.Thrombosis, taking the values 0, 1, 2 and 3.
scope: Examination-level characterisation of thrombotic status in thrombosis_prediction

name: Thrombotic Event
definition: The presence of clinically recorded thrombosis for an examination record, operationally represented by a Thrombosis grade greater than zero.
scope: Binary thrombosis outcome analysis; 0 versus non-zero only, because no value legend is published in the environment

name: Thrombosis Symptom Description
definition: The free-text Symptoms field of an examination record, describing the clinical manifestation when a thrombotic event is present.
scope: Interpretation and categorisation of recorded thrombotic manifestations

name: Textual Thrombotic Manifestation
definition: A thrombotic event expressed as free text rather than as an ordinal code, appearing in the Symptoms field and in the Diagnosis field of the examination and patient tables (for example brain infarction, pulmonary emboli, DVT, thrombosis, spleen infarction).
scope: Free-text discovery of thrombotic events that are not captured by the ordinal grade alone

name: Antiphospholipid Antibody
definition: The family of antiphospholipid-related laboratory determinations recorded on an examination record, comprising lupus anticoagulant and anticardiolipin antibody measurements.
scope: Antiphospholipid serology analysis in the thrombosis_prediction examination table

name: Lupus Anticoagulant
definition: The lupus anticoagulant determination recorded in Examination, based on phospholipid-dependent clotting tests and stored in the LAC field as a qualitative result.
scope: Coagulation-based antiphospholipid assessment per examination record

name: Anticardiolipin Antibody
definition: Anticardiolipin antibody measurements recorded on an examination record in three isotype-specific fields, aCL IgG, aCL IgM and aCL IgA, each stored as a numeric value.
scope: Isotype-resolved anticardiolipin serology per examination record

name: Coagulation and Fibrinolysis Panel
definition: The coagulation and fibrinolysis measurements recorded in the Laboratory table, comprising prothrombin time, activated partial thromboplastin time, fibrinogen and the molecular haemostatic markers PIC, TAT and TAT2.
scope: Laboratory-level haemostatic activity analysis

name: Platelet Count
definition: The platelet count recorded in the Laboratory table as PLT.
scope: Laboratory-level thrombocytopenia assessment

name: Antinuclear Antibody Titer
definition: The antinuclear antibody titre recorded on an examination record in the ANA field as an integer.
scope: Examination-level autoreactivity assessment

name: ANA Staining Pattern
definition: The immunofluorescence staining pattern recorded alongside the ANA titre in the ANA Pattern field of an examination record.
scope: Examination-level interpretation of antinuclear antibody staining

name: Autoantibody Panel
definition: The extractable nuclear antigen autoantibody determinations recorded in the Laboratory table across the RNP, SM, SC170, SSA, SSB and CENTROMEA fields.
scope: Laboratory-level autoantibody specificity analysis

name: Anti-dsDNA Antibody
definition: The anti-double-stranded-DNA antibody measurement recorded in the Laboratory table; the environment provides the DNA field and an additional DNA-II field.
scope: Laboratory-level analysis of double-stranded DNA antibody reactivity

name: Rheumatoid Factor
definition: The rheumatoid factor determination recorded in the Laboratory table, present in the environment under two distinct fields with different encodings, RA and RF.
scope: Laboratory-level rheumatoid factor analysis

name: Complement Component
definition: The complement components recorded in the Laboratory table as C3 and C4.
scope: Laboratory-level complement consumption analysis

name: C-Reactive Protein
definition: The C-reactive protein measurement recorded in the Laboratory table as CRP, stored as text that may hold a censored rather than an exact value.
scope: Laboratory-level acute-phase and inflammatory activity analysis

name: Urinary Protein
definition: The urinary protein determination recorded in the Laboratory table as U-PRO, stored as text that mixes categorical and numeric expressions.
scope: Laboratory-level renal involvement assessment

name: Autoimmune Disease Diagnosis
definition: The disease label recorded for a patient on the patient record and, independently, on each examination record, drawn from the collagen-vascular and autoimmune disease vocabulary of this cohort.
scope: Cohort definition and disease subgroup analysis

name: Sex
definition: The recorded sex of the patient, stored in Patient.SEX as a single-letter code.
scope: Demographic stratification of the cohort

name: Age at First Visit
definition: The patient's age in years on the first visit date, computed from the recorded birthday and the first visit date.
scope: Age-standardised cohort description; requires both birthday and first visit date to be present

name: First Visit Date
definition: The patient-level date recorded in Patient.'First Date', representing the patient's earliest recorded contact in the cohort.
scope: Index date for patient-level follow-up and interval computation

name: Observation Date
definition: The date on which a measurement event occurred, recorded as Examination.'Examination Date' for examination records and as Laboratory.Date for laboratory records.
scope: Event-time ordering and longitudinal alignment of records

name: Admission Flag
definition: The coarse flag recorded in Patient.Admission summarising the patient's admission status.
scope: Inpatient versus outpatient stratification; the meaning of each coded form is not documented in the environment
